Name: Isla - Custom NPC
Author: PaperNautilus
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=3]Isla (Eye-la) is a mysterious water spirit who you'll find roaming the shores of Pelican Town on her days off. What are her secrets? If you befriend her, she may let you know.
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][b][font=Georgia][size=3][color=#a4c2f4]Events: [/color]
[/size][/font][/b][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]Isla is away with her mermaid troupe on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays, so her events will not trigger on these days. The weather must be sunny for all events.[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3][color=#6fa8dc]
Introduction: (You must view this event to meet Isla). The beach bridge must also be fixed for the event to trigger. 

[/color][/size][/font][color=#6fa8dc][font=Georgia][size=3] ﻿Part I: Follow the path to the north of your farm to Robin and Demetrius’ house between (before 18:00). 
[/size][/font][/color][font=Georgia][size=3][color=#6fa8dc] ﻿﻿Part II: Follow Isla (before 18:00). [/color]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3][color=#b6d7a8]
2-heart event: Go to the Beach between 9:00 and 17:00.
[/color][/size][/font][color=#ffe599][font=Georgia][size=3]
4-heart event: Go to the Beach between 9:00 and 17:00.[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][/color][font=Georgia][size=3][color=#e06666]
﻿6-heart event: Go to the Beach between 9:00 and 17:00.[/color][/size][/font][font=Georgia][color=#e06666][size=3]

﻿P[/color][/size][/font][color=#b4a7d6][font=Georgia][size=3]art I: Go to the Beach between 9:00 and 17:00. [/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]﻿
﻿Part II: Go to Pierre's Shop between 19:00 and 22:00.[/size][/font][/color][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3][color=#d9d2e9]
[/color][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3][color=#6fa8dc]10-heart event: You will receive a letter from Isla in the mail. Meet her at the Beach between 22:00-23:00.[/color]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[color=#d5a6bd]14-heart event: You will receive an invitation in the mail from Isla. This event will only trigger in the Spring ﻿or Summer. Meet her down at the Beach between 22:00-23:00.[/color][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][b][font=Georgia][size=3]
[color=#a4c2f4]Gift tastes: 
[/color][/size][/font][/b][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]Loves: Pearl, Seafoam Pudding, Ocean Stone, Dish O' the Sea. [/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
Likes: Salmon dinner,  Nautilus Shell, Maki Roll, Rainbow Shell, Blue Jazz, Algae Soup, Pale Broth, Fairy Rose, Fish Stew, Chowder, Lobster Bisque, Purple Mushroom. [/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
Neutral: Coral, Clam, Crystal Fruit, Seaweed.[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
Dislikes: Geode, Frozen Geode, Magma Geode, Omni Geode, Fiber, Milk, Egg, Wild Horseradish, Dandelion, Leek.[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
Hates: Escargot, Parsnip Soup, Fried Mushroom, Beer, Wine, Green Slime, Bean Hotpot, Clay, Soggy Newspaper, Broken CD, Broken Glasses, Joja Cola.
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3][color=#a4c2f4][b]Birthday:[/b] [/color]

Winter 18
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][b][font=Georgia][size=3][color=#a4c2f4]Where to find Isla: 
[/color][/size][/font][/b][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]Isla is away on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays. In the early morning, she can be found standing outside her home. In the late morning, she can be found around the tide pool area, and then in the afternoon, she can be found around the Beach area (usually standing on one of the docks). In the evening, she returns back home.[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][b][font=Georgia][size=3]
[color=#a4c2f4]How to visit Isla: 
[/color][/size][/font][/b][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]Isla's home is accessible by boat. In order to visit her, you must interact with the tile beside the boat at the end of the Tide Pool dock (it operates like a door). You can visit Isla in her home after 20:00 on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays. Also, you can fish in the water around Isla’s cave!
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]In order to return to the Beach, you must also interact with the tile by the boat (the dock tile just beside the bow of the boat).  
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]

[/size][/color][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ffffff][size=3]Unique seasonal outfits (including a Spirit's Eve costume)[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ffffff][size=3]Custom festival locations and dialogue[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ffffff][size=3]Custom children (with both dark and light skin variations) [/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ffffff][size=3]A custom spouse room[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ffffff][size=3]A custom home[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ffffff][size=3]6 heart events (including a 14-heart event)[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ffffff][size=3]Movie theatre preferences[/size][/color][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][b][size=3][color=#a4c2f4]Credits: 
[/color][/size][/b][size=3]
[/size][size=3]Special thanks to: Lemurkat, Jonqora, WatchfulTigerlily, FlashShifter, Blaaze6, Platonymous, Pathoschild, Agent Lyoko, and everyone else on Discord. I couldn't have made her without your help!
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]Thanks also to ManaKirel, whose Vintage Interface (Content Patcher) mod I used for Isla’s portrait boxes. Because of Isla's desaturated colours, I think she looks best when played with this mod!

[b][color=#a4c2f4]Updates: 

[/color][/b](September 28th, 2020) 

I have just added a Starblue Valley recolour variant for Isla's Maps. Thanks also to strangelyliteral, the creator of the Starblue Valley mod, whose tilesheets I used for this Maps recolour. 

[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869][size=3]Starblue Valley[/size]

[/url][size=3](May 16th, 2021)

Two new alternative portraits. Both omena007 and AEscraed's portraits can be found as their own separate mods. 

[color=#a4c2f4][b]Editions:[/b][/color]

1.23

I just removed the Lockeddoorwarp at the end of the dock. Now you can visit Isla's home any time. This will make it easier for players to visit Isla in the evenings. 

1.24

Fixed Isla's marriage dialogue conflict. 

1.25

Fixed Isla's movie preferences. 

1.26

Mod files re-packed by Lemurkat to be compatible with PC. 

1.27

Fixed schedule error. 

1.28 (Uploaded on March 10th, 2021)

Version number updated, festival placements corrected, and a new feature added (Isla performs at the mermaid show). Thanks to gwenynnefydd for letting me use their Diverse Mermaid Show coordinates!

I've also uploaded a Diverse variant for Isla (found under optional files), as well as a Grampleton Fields compatibility patch (special thanks to MaverickWolf and Majickian for sorting this out!)

If you would like to see pictures of Isla's Diverse variant please look under Images. 

2.0 (Uploaded October 30th, 2022)

Just updated the files from TMXL to CP. Thanks to Agent Lyoko for converting the files for me!

2.02 (Uploaded March 6th, 2023). 

Minor bug fixes. Thanks again to Agent Lyoko for addressing the issues!

[/size][b][size=3][color=#a4c2f4]And Lastly: 
[/color][/size][/b][size=3]
[/size][size=3]I hope you enjoy this mod! This is my very first, so I expect that there will be bugs and incompatibilities. If you’d like to contact me directly, the best place to reach me is on Discord (PaperNautilus#0858). You can also reach out to me via Nexus, of course![/size][size=3]
